name: rosetta-hofstadter-q-sequence
code:
use default

q_sequence(count: int) -> List[int] is
    let terms = LIST([0, 1, 1])

    for n in 3::count do
        terms.add(terms[n - terms[n - 1]] + terms[n - terms[n - 2]])
    od

    return terms
si

let terms = q_sequence(100000)

write_line("first ten terms: {terms |> skip(1) |> take(10) |> join(" ")}")
write_line("term 1000: {terms[1000]}")

let descents = (2::100000)
    |> filter(n => terms[n] < terms[n - 1])
    |> count()

write_line("terms below their predecessor up to 100000: {descents}")
